primary_failure: Any omitted dialogue or narration content, including text never detected by OCR
verbatim_allowed: Sound effects and onomatopoeia such as sniff can remain unchanged; their unchanged spelling is not itself a failure
sound_effect_classification: Judge the original visual context; a sound word inside spoken dialogue is not automatically exempt
proper_names: Do not require translating names, but preserve their presence and identity in dialogue
translation_equivalence: Preserve every meaningful element; grammatical changes needed for natural Spanish are allowed
screen_pass_requires: Original visible text inventory and the entire output visually reviewed on the same frozen Windows build
